name: agent-with-tool-budget
description: An agentic loop with a hard turn cap (max_turns, clamped [1,32], default 8) plus a preflight cost-admission cap (max_cost_usd). The loop can terminate as Incomplete with stop_reason=budget_exhausted before starting later work, but this is not a reservation or settlement ceiling: a started turn can still settle above the cap. The runaway-repeat detector trips on RUNAWAY_REPEAT_THRESHOLD consecutive byte-identical steps (the fastest agent-spend leak — it catches a stuck loop before a static cost cap). Use this template as a bounded-admission starting point, then add runtime reservation/settlement for a true spend ceiling.

nodes.prompt: You are a coding assistant. Use the provided tools to read files + answer the question concisely. Question: {{input.text}}
